developer_reply: Hi, Tiago, thanks for the 5-star rating! We've taken your suggestion to heart and we're planning on making some changes based on your thoughtful review. If there's anything else we can do to help, please contact our customer support via Book Morning! Settings → FAQ & Support → Contact us and we'll hop into it. Thanks! - Fourdesire Support
